svg.title: Attempt outcomes and selected token metric availability are separate populations
svg.desc: Eight constructed attempts include one rejected and seven admitted. Admitted outcomes are four normal one error one cancelled one unresolved. Two have observed selected ID TTFT, three terminate without selection, one is confirmed unfinished without selection and one selected output but lost the first timestamp. Observed mean nineteen point five milliseconds and coverage two out of seven describe a selected subset not a service distribution.
svg.text: First-token evidence needs an outcome and availability ledger
2 observed TTFTs: A = 32 ms, D = 7 ms (EOS included)
3 terminal no-selection cases: C (cap 0), G (error), H (cancel)
1 authoritative no-selection-yet case: E at cutoff
1 missing timestamp despite selected output: F
Observed mean = 19.5 ms; observed coverage = 2 / 7 admitted
E has waited at least 56 ms without selection, not a completed TTFT.
An empty visible result can still have a selected EOS event.
Constructed coverage corpus, not measured latency frequencies or service reliability.
